productiondate.title: Returned to Production
productiondate.remarks: The date and time when the person confirms that the area was returned to production.

crossareacountsig.title: Cross Area Counter Signature Required
crossareacountsig.remarks: Indicates whether a counter signature is required. This signature is from an authorized person who is responsible for another area that is affected by the isolation certificate.

shift.title: Work Shift
shift.remarks: The work shift for which the permit to work is required. Valid values are in the PERMITWORKSHIFTS domain.

isolationsremoved.title: Isolation Removal Verified
isolationsremoved.remarks: Indicates whether the required isolations that are associated with this permit were removed.

createdate.title: Created
createdate.remarks: The date and time when the isolation certificate was created.

closureenterpmtrgt.title: Entered in Permit Registry
closureenterpmtrgt.remarks: Indicates whether the permit to work is added to the permit registry.

closurerevdate.title: Review Date
closurerevdate.remarks: The date and time when the permit to work record was reviewed.

ownergroup.title: Owner Group
ownergroup.remarks: The group that owns the isolation certificate.You can change ownership of the isolation certificate using the Select Owner or the Take Ownership actions.

masterlockinuse.title: Lock Box Locked and In Use
masterlockinuse.remarks: Flag indicating that the selected Lock Box andKey are applied and actually being in use in the Isolation.

plusggroupcode.title: Grouping Code
plusggroupcode.remarks: The code that is used to group related permits to work, such as those for projects or for turnarounds. Valid values are in the PLUSGGROUPINGCODE domain. You can change this value in any status except when the status of the permit to work is Canceled or Closed.

closuresitecleared.title: Work Site Cleared
closuresitecleared.remarks: Indicates whether the work site was cleared when the permit to work was cancelled.

plusgcontrolssumm.title: Controls Summary
plusgcontrolssumm.remarks: A summary of the controls. The summary is based on the controls identified to address hazards identified by the hazard review.

lockreturned.title: Lock Returned
lockreturned.remarks: Indicates that all locks and keys that are associated with the access permit have been returned.

permitunit.title: Unit
permitunit.remarks: The unit that is associated with the permit to work record.

thirdparty.title: Third Party
thirdparty.remarks: Specifies whether a third party is involved in the completion of the permit to work request.

requireddate.title: Required Date
requireddate.remarks: The date and time when the isolation certificate is required.

status.title: Status
status.remarks: The status of the isolation certificate record. Valid statuses are in the PLUSGPERWORKSTATUS synonym domain.

template.title: Template
template.remarks: Indicates that the record can be used as a template to create other isolation certificate records. Only certain fields and their values are duplicated. Those fields and their values are copied from the originating record to the new record.

gastestrepeatfreq.title: Gas Test Repeat Frequency
gastestrepeatfreq.remarks: The frequency, in hours or on a daily basis, of gas testing.

permitunits.title: Units
permitunits.remarks: The unit of time for which the permit to work is valid.

assetnum.title: Asset
assetnum.remarks: The asset that is associated with the isolation certificate record.

isoreason.title: Reason for Isolation
isoreason.remarks: Describes the reason for the isolation.

refdrawing.title: Reference Drawing
refdrawing.remarks: The reference drawing that is associated with the lock out and tag out operation.

riskcomments.title: Comments
riskcomments.remarks: Additional comments for the current risk assessment.

confspaceauthid.title: Confined Space Controller
confspaceauthid.remarks: The unique identifier of the person who is assigned to enter the confined space.

contgastestreqd.title: Continuous Gas Testing Required
contgastestreqd.remarks: Indicates whether gas testing is required on a continual basis to ensure the safety of the plant.

specisolation.title: Isolation Specialist
specisolation.remarks: Indicates whether the isolation requires a specialist who is familiar with handling this type of isolation, such as high voltage electrical isolation.

confspaceauth.title: Confined Space Controller
confspaceauth.remarks: The person who is assigned to enter the confined space.

statusdate.title: Status Date
statusdate.remarks: The server date and time when the permit to work record was created, or when the status changed of the permit to work record. This value is read-only.

sitechecked.title: Initial Site Check
sitechecked.remarks: Specifies whether there must be an initial verification of the site that is associated with the permit to work.

closurecomments.title: Comments
closurecomments.remarks: Comments arising from the review of the permit to work record.

masterpermit.title: Master Permit
masterpermit.remarks: Specifies whether this permit to work record is a master permit.

closurelessonslearned.title: Lessons Learned
closurelessonslearned.remarks: Indicates whether a lessons learned meeting was held or there are lessons learned that are associated with this permit to work record.

workinghours.title: Working Hours
workinghours.remarks: Advisory information, such as Daylight Only, on the working hours that are associated with a permit to work.

tbtcompletedby.title: Toolbox Talk Completed By
tbtcompletedby.remarks: The person who is responsible for holding the toolbox talk.

workcompleted.title: Work Completed
workcompleted.remarks: Indicates whether the work that is associated with the permit to work is complete.

safeconditiondate.title: Returned to Safe Condition
safeconditiondate.remarks: The date and time when the person confirms that the plant was returned to a safe condition.

masterlockbox.title: Lock
masterlockbox.remarks: The identifier for a lock box that can hold multiple keys that are associated with a group of related isolations. The person who does the work holds the key to the master lock box.

attacheddoc.title: Documentation Attached
attacheddoc.remarks: The attachments for the lock out and tag out plan that is associated with the permit to work.

selfisolation.title: Self Isolation
selfisolation.remarks: Specifies whether the person doing the work is cleared to carry out his or her own isolation.

siteid.title: Site
siteid.remarks: The site that is associated with the isolation certificate record.

details.title: Details
details.remarks: Detailed information about the permit to work.

extdescription.title: Reason for Extension
extdescription.remarks: The reason why the permit to work is extended. Operational rules might dictate that a permit to work requires an extension.

activitycategory.title: Activity Category
activitycategory.remarks: The category of the activity that is associated with the isolation certificate, such as chemical operations or production operations.

riskcopiedfromwo.title: Risk Assessment Copied from Work Order or Task
riskcopiedfromwo.remarks: Indicates whether the risk assessment was copied from the work order or the task that generated the permit to work.

changedate.title: Change Date
changedate.remarks: The date and time when the permit to work record was extended.

permitlevel.title: Permit Level
permitlevel.remarks: The level of risk that is associated with the permit to work record, depending on the nature of the task.

orgid.title: Organization
orgid.remarks: The organization that is associated with the site of the permit to work record.

sitecheckedbyid.title: Site Checked By
sitecheckedbyid.remarks: The person who verified the work site.

tbtcompleteddate.title: Toolbox Talk Completed
tbtcompleteddate.remarks: The date and time when the person confirms that the toolbox talk was completed.

plusghazardsumm.title: Hazard Summary
plusghazardsumm.remarks: A summary of the hazards. The summary is based on the risk assessment analysis that was done for the permit to work.

sitecheckeddate.title: Site Checked
sitecheckeddate.remarks: The date and time when the person confirms that the work site was  verified.

changedby.title: Changed By
changedby.remarks: The person who was logged in when the duration for the permit to work was extended.

plusgprocedureid.title: Operating Procedure
plusgprocedureid.remarks: The  procedures that are to be used for the lock out and tag out operation.

routesid.title: Asset List
routesid.remarks: The list of assets or locations that are associated with the lock out and tag out operations. Use the Asset List application to create lists of assets and associated locations.

inhibitsremoved.title: Inhibits Removed
inhibitsremoved.remarks: Indicates whether any inhibits that are associated with this permit are removed. For example, an alarm circuit was shut down so that maintenance work could proceed. The alarm circuit must be reactivated.

pertypenum.title: Permit and Certificate Type
pertypenum.remarks: The type of permit or certificate that is associated with the isolation certificate record. The status of the type of permit or certificate must be active.

riskassessreq.title: Risk Assessment Required
riskassessreq.remarks: Specifies whether a risk assessment must be performed for this permit to work record.

safecondition.title: Returned to Safe Condition
safecondition.remarks: Indicates whether the plant was returned to a safe condition, and is ready to be returned to production.

production.title: Returned to Production
production.remarks: Indicates whether the asset or the location that is associated with this permit was returned to production.

resultnum.title: Inspection Result
resultnum.remarks: The number of the inspection result.

description.title: Description
description.remarks: A description of the permit to work record.

toolboxcomments.title: Comments
toolboxcomments.remarks: A description of the toolbox talk that was held and the information that was shared between the team and the person who held the toolbox talk. A toolbox talk is a safety presentation that is given to inform personnel about safety procedures.

plusgtotalscore.title: Total Score
plusgtotalscore.remarks: The total score that is assigned to the hazards that are associated with the permit to work.

closureauditrequired.title: Audit Required
closureauditrequired.remarks: Indicates whether an audit is required to ensure the quality of the permit to work activities and processes.

isolationsremoveddate.title: Isolation Removed
isolationsremoveddate.remarks: The date and time when the person confirms that the isolations were removed.

permitworknum.title: Isolation Certificate
permitworknum.remarks: The identifier of the isolation certificate record.

isocert.title: Isolation Certificate
isocert.remarks: Indicates whether the permit and certificate type applies to an isolation certificate.

riskrevised.title: Copied Risk Assessment Revised
riskrevised.remarks: Indicates whether the risk assessment was modified after it was copied from the work order or the task.

owner.title: Owner
owner.remarks: The owner of the isolation certificate. You can change ownership of the isolation certificate using the Select Owner or the Take Ownership actions.

longtermiso.title: Long Term Isolation
longtermiso.remarks: Indicates whether the isolation is long term so that users of the isolation certificate or associated permits are aware that the isolation is planned to be in place over an extended period of time.

ptwclass.title: Permit Class
ptwclass.remarks: The class of permit. The class can be either a permit to work or an isolation certificate. Valid values are in the PLUSGPTWCLASS domain.

inhibitsremoveddate.title: Inhibits Removed
inhibitsremoveddate.remarks: The date and time when the person confirms that the inhibits were removed. An inhibit is associated with alarm panels, emergency shutdown systems, and fire and gas systems. For example, you inhibit an alarm circuit to carry out maintenance work. The inhibit is removed when it is safe to do so.

workcompleteddate.title: Work Completed
workcompleteddate.remarks: The date and time when the person confirms that the work was completed.

permitvalidity.title: Validity
permitvalidity.remarks: The amount of hours or days during which the permit to work is valid.

requestor.title: Requestor
requestor.remarks: The person who is requesting the permit to work. The requestor is the logged on user who creates the permit to work.

extnum.title: Extension
extnum.remarks: The number of the extension for the permit to work record. A permit to work must be in Isolation Complete, Approved, Active, or Suspended status for its duration to be extended. When you extend a permit to work, the permit validity is increased by the value in the Extension Period in Hours field. An extension number is generated. The extension number starts with 0 and increments by 1 for each subsequent extension.

tbtcompleted.title: Toolbox Talk
tbtcompleted.remarks: Specifies whether a toolbox talk must be held for employees prior to starting the work. The purpose of the toolbox talk is to communicate safe working procedures.

origresultnum.title: Originating Inspection
origresultnum.remarks: The number of the originating conduct an inspection record.

location.title: Location
location.remarks: The location that is associated with the isolation certificate record.

inspformnum.title: Inspection Form
inspformnum.remarks: The number of the inspection form.

plusgsafetycrit.title: Safety-critical
plusgsafetycrit.remarks: Indicates that the permit to work is associated with a safety-critical location.
